name: UploadServerCertificate

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` and `acs:`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
服务器证书部署的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh:
阿里云签发证书ID。

如果使用阿里云签发证书，该参数必选

parameters.help_zh:
阿里云签发证书名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465112.html接口查询证书名称。

如果使用阿里云签发证书，该参数必选
parameters.name: ali_cloud_certificate_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of AliCloud certificate
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云签发证书所属的地域ID。
如果使用阿里云签发证书，该参数必选
parameters.name: ali_cloud_certificate_region_id

parameters.help_en: The server certificate to be uploaded
parameters.help_zh:
需要上传的公钥证书。

如果上传非阿里云签发证书，该参数必选
parameters.name: server_certificate

parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- MIIEogIB****** -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The private key of the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
需要上传的私钥。  

如果上传非阿里云签发证书，该参数必选
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the server certificate.

The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length. It must start with an English letter. It can contain letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
要上传的非阿里云签发的服务器证书的名称。长度限制为1~80个字符，允许包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和星号（*）。

如果上传非阿里云签发证书，该参数必选
parameters.name: server_certificate_name

CommonName.description_en: The domain name of the CA certificate
CommonName.description_zh: 域名，对应证书的`Common Name`字段

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the CA certificate is uploaded

CreateTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp generated when the CA certificate is uploaded

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the CA certificate expires

ExpireTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp generated when the CA certificate expires

Fingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint of the CA certificate

IsAliCloudCertificate.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is provided by Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service. Valid values:

0: The certificate is not provided by Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service.

1: The certificate is provided by Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service
IsAliCloudCertificate.description_zh:
是否为阿里云证书服务中的证书。

0：不是阿里云证书。
1：是阿里云证书

RegionId.description_en:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html） operation to query the most recent region list
RegionId.description_zh: 服务器证书部署的地域ID
